settings.censorDescription: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
settings.backupRetentionDescription: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
settings.aiFeedbackDescription: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
settings.feedbackUnset: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
settings.signOutDescription: Sign out of this Paperclip instance. You will be redirected to the login page.
settings.renameCaution: Renaming can change this company's task ID prefix. Existing task IDs are renumbered and old task links stop resolving.
settings.requireApproval: Require board approval for new hires
settings.saveOwnerImmediately: Each owner saves as soon as you choose it.
settings.archiveOrgDescription: Archive this organization to hide it from the sidebar. This persists in the database.
settings.profileDescription: Control how your account appears in the sidebar and other board surfaces.
settings.clickAvatar: Click the avatar to upload a new image.
settings.displayNameDescription: Shown in the sidebar account footer and comment author surfaces.
settings.readOnlyEmail: Email is managed by your auth session and is read-only here.
